accuracy: The persona debate got 50% exactly right vs 45% for a single agent (n = 20; wide intervals).
critical_miss: A single agent called 56% of critical patients non-urgent; with the debate, 33% slipped through without a nurse seeing them.
coverage: At the default setting the debate sends 5% of cases to a nurse and is right on 53% of the rest.
auroc: Agent disagreement flags errors no better than a single agent's own confidence (AUROC 0.68 vs 0.69).
cost: The debate costs 3.8 calls and 3,654 tokens per patient, about 4.7x a single agent.
fairness: Swapping only the patient's sex changed the decision in 2 of 14 cases for a single agent and 3 of 14 for the debate.
